name: Salon
author: Mert Hurturk
description: A painting in your bar: click for a random work by the artists you choose, with its title, date and a few lines about it. Keep favourites, browse them in a grid, and see any painting full screen.

barWidget.description: Click for a painting; right-click for another; middle-click to open its page.

schema.label: Artists
schema.description: Comma-separated, as WikiArt names them, e.g. Francis Bacon, Philip Guston, Egon Schiele. Leave empty for the built-in masters (Goya, Bosch, Bruegel, Rembrandt, Turner, Van Gogh). A new list is built on this computer in the background, which can take a few minutes.

schema.label: Paintings per artist
schema.description: The most a built collection keeps of any one artist. More means a longer first build.

schema.label: Sync favourites to Context Engine
schema.description: Auto saves each favourite as a Context Engine note when the Context Engine plugin is installed, so your other machines share them. Off keeps favourites on this computer only.
